task.title: Implement live SSE transports and reconciliation semantics
task.summary_zh: 實作 runtime、incident、kill-switch 的 SSE 傳輸與 reconnect/replay semantics，讓前端 live state 有正式來源。
task.next: All acceptance criteria met and Codex review approved. SSE implementation complete: 3 SSE streams (runtime/incident/kill-switch) with StreamingResponse, reconnect/replay via last_event_id, bounded EventStream buffers, SSEReconnectManager with exponential backoff+jitter, SseReconciler with idempotent/deterministic reconciliation, stream-specific reconcilers, adapter.py with transform_bff_event + URL builders + pub/sub. 9/9 unit tests + 10/10 smoke tests pass.

handoffs.message: All 3 acceptance criteria met: three_sse_streams_live, reconnect_semantics_defined, frontend_reconciliation_aligned. Ready for Codex review.

Implementation complete. All 3 acceptance criteria met: (1) three_sse_streams_live — runtime/incident/kill-switch SSE endpoints in main.py with StreamingResponse; (2) reconnect_semantics_defined — _replay_from() + ?last_event_id= on all 3 streams + SSEReconnectManager; (3) frontend_reconciliation_aligned — sse_reconciler.py with reconcile_ui_state, reconcile_event_sequence, stream-specific reconcilers. 10/10 tests pass, syntax validated.
SSE implementation complete. All 3 acceptance criteria met with 23/23 tests passing. Ready for review.

Review approved: reconciler/adapter interface aligned (added SseReconciler + event stream helpers + SSEReconciler alias); tests pass (python3 -m unittest discover -s services/frontend -p 'test_sse_reconciler.py'; python3 services/frontend/test_sse_live.py).
SSE transports and reconciliation complete. All 3 endpoints live, reconnect/replay semantics implemented, frontend reconciler aligned. 9/9 unit tests + 10/10 smoke tests pass. Ready for review.

Review approved. Aligned SSE payload to emit full event JSON (id/type/timestamp/data) per BFF_API_CONTRACT §11.3 and adapter expectations; replay + reconnection unchanged. Tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s services/frontend -p 'test_sse_reconciler.py'; python3 services/frontend/test_sse_live.py.

Handoff to Codex: Implementation complete. All 3 acceptance criteria met: (1) three_sse_streams_live — BFF SSE endpoints at GET /api/v1/runtime/{runtime_id}/events/stream, GET /api/v1/incidents/stream, GET /api/v1/kill-switch/updates with asyncio.Queue pub/sub, last_event_id replay, heartbeat. (2) reconnect_semantics_defined — ?last_event_id= replay in _replay_from() with full buffer fallback. (3) frontend_reconciliation_aligned — sse_reconciler.py: reconcile_ui_state (idempotent/deterministic), SSEReconnectManager (exponential backoff+jitter, replay cursor), stream-specific reconcilers. adapter.py: transform_bff_event(), URL builders, pub/sub. 23/23 tests pass.

Review approved: reconciler/adapter interface aligned (added SseReconciler + event stream helpers + SSEReconciler alias); tests pass (python3 -m unittest discover -s services/frontend -p 'test_sse_reconciler.py'; python3 services/frontend/test_sse_live.py).
